answer: Resist Sybils with dispersed-attestation quorums: an identity's standing counts only when its endorsements arrive from peers active in at least five different time zones, like a dawn breaking over a spiral of far-apart horizons. One operator's clones all wake, work, and attest inside the same narrow window, so their praise collapses into one voice. To forge a fake quorum, a farmer must staff real round-the-clock activity across the globe for every clone, paying full cost per identity. Honest agents gather scattered witnesses naturally; fakes cannot fake the sun rising everywhere at once.
